blocks.text: Vivica A. Fox New Futura Fiber Wig – BLONDIE 30-Inch Layered Straight Style with Invisible Side Part Step into elegance and length with the Vivica A. Fox BLONDIE Wig, crafted from premium New Futura fiber for a natural look and feel. This 30-inch layered straight style features an invisible side part for seamless blending, offering a salon-quality finish right out of the box. Key Features: 30-Inch Length – Long, luxurious layers for a sleek and glamorous look. Invisible Side Part – Seamlessly blends with your natural hairline. Straight Layered Style – Timeless and elegant with soft movement. New Futura Fiber – Heat-resistant synthetic fiber that mimics the texture of human hair. Comfortable Fit – Breathable cap construction designed for secure, all-day wear. Color Shown: Blonde – Vibrant and trendy color (availability may vary). Care Instructions: 1. General Care Tips: -Do not use heavy products like oil or spritz—this may cause tangling and shedding. -Wash gently with lukewarm water; finger-comb only. Do not brush while wet. -Always air dry on a wig stand. Do not use blow dryers. -Avoid sleeping while wearing the wig to prevent matting and style damage. 2. Styling Tips: -Shake the wig after removing it from the packaging. -Use your fingers to separate layers or curls. Do not brush curly styles. -For straight styles, gently comb with a wide-tooth comb or your fingers, starting from the ends and working upward. -For restyling, especially with human hair wigs, professional assistance is recommended. 3. Washing & Conditioning: -Detangle gently before washing. -Wet the wig with lukewarm water. -Apply shampoo from top to bottom using your fingers. Rinse with cool water. -Apply conditioner in the same manner. Rinse with lukewarm water. -Pat dry with a towel—do not wring or twist. -Place on a wig stand or over a can of hairspray to air dry.
